items.reason: D31-B14: roles follow the record's description, not the registered arm type; the record says patients 'will be randomized to receive either pembrolizumab or a placebo as an addition', so pembrolizumab in the ACTIVE_COMPARATOR-registered arm is a candidate.

Pembrolizumab is the only pharmacological agent; the DC vaccine is an excluded type ('allogeneic dendritic cells derived from healthy donors fused with autologous tumor cells'), matching the manual's 'Pembrolizumab + an investigational vaccine' example.

For the pembrolizumab question, the comparator is vaccine plus placebo, i.e. the EXPERIMENTAL-labelled 'DC Vaccine Arm' ('randomized to receive either pembrolizumab or a placebo as an addition'), so an EXPERIMENTAL-labelled arm works as the control. The [CODE] control_arm is yes anyway because of the PLACEBO_COMPARATOR arm.

note: S6 settled by D31-B14 (pembrolizumab is a candidate despite the ACTIVE_COMPARATOR arm label). 'Confirmed IDH status' requires no IDH value, so it is testing only and any_molecular_selection stays false. Nothing pending for XL.
